_about: Indian trading costs used by every Phase 4 test. Percent values are % of traded value. Rates follow the owner's brief (Part A2) where it gives them; I am not sure every rate matches the latest NSE/SEBI circulars: check https://www.nseindia.com and your broker's charges page before relying on them.

delivery.brokerage_note: discount broker: zero brokerage on delivery
delivery.dp_note: charged once per stock per day it is sold from demat (about Rs 13.5 + GST)

slippage_pct_per_side.note: ADV = average daily traded value over the last 60 sessions; orders fill at the next open plus this slippage
